name: Browser Act
description: Do one action in this chat's browser tab and read the page after: click, fill (replace a field's text), type (key by key), press (Enter, Escape, Tab, Backspace, an arrow or a character, or Shift with Tab or an arrow; no Control, Meta or Alt), select (an option, by label), check, uncheck, hover, scroll_down, scroll_up, back, forward, reload, wait (text = seconds, at most 10). Never type a password, card number or code: use browser-login or browser-handoff. Ask the user before anything that sends, buys, posts or deletes.
author: anything

ref.description: The element's ref from the last read (e12); not for page-wide press or scroll, back, forward, reload or wait.

text.description: Text for fill and type, the key for press, the option for select, seconds for wait.
